The Writ Petition is filed seeking to declare the inaction on the part of the respondents in paying the amount of compensation awarded in respect of the lands, which were acquired from petitioners by passing a consent Award No.01/2021-2022 dated 15.09.2021 for an extent of Ac.0.87 cents situated at Chiramana Village, A.S.Peta Mandal, SPSR Nellore District, as illegal, arbitrary and violative of the rights guaranteed under Articles 19, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and for a consequential direction to the respondents to pay the compensation amount of Rs.5,23,636/-
with the interest @ 15% p.a., from date of Award 15.09.2021 till the date of payment as per the Sec.80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013(for short 'the Act').

opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__PREAMBLE:
Between vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 21 July, 2023
Author: Ninala Jayasurya
Bench: Ninala Jayasurya
 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh :: Amaravati
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya
 Writ Petition No.18117 of 2023
Between:-
Katuru Janardhan Reddy & Others .... Petitioners
 And
The State of Andhra Pradesh,
Rep.by its Principal Secretary(Irrigation Department)
Secretariat, Velagapudi, Guntur District & Others. ..... Respondents
opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__facts:
With the consent of both the parties, the Writ Petition is disposed of at the stage of admission.
2. The Writ Petition is filed seeking to declare the inaction on the part of the respondents in paying the amount of compensation awarded in respect of the lands, which were acquired from petitioners by passing a consent Award No.01/2021-2022 dated 15.09.2021 for an extent of Ac.0.87 cents situated at Chiramana Village, A.S.Peta Mandal, SPSR Nellore District, as illegal, arbitrary and violative of the rights guaranteed under Articles 19, 21 and 300-A of the Constitution of India and for a consequential direction to the respondents to pay the compensation amount of Rs.5,23,636/-
with the interest @ 15% p.a., from date of Award 15.09.2021 till the date of payment as per the Sec.80 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013(for short 'the Act').
3.
opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__arguments:
He submits that the said lands were acquired for the purpose of Somasila Project.
He submits that an Award No.01/2021-2022 dated 15.09.2021 was passed granting a compensation of Rs.5,23,636/-.
But the compensation has not been paid to the petitioners.
He Between vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170099773/
1 further submits that non-payment of compensation is unjust, arbitrary and the delay in payment of compensation is causing serious prejudice and irreparable loss to the petitioners.
opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__decision:
There is no dispute with regard to taking over possession of the lands in question and passing of Award.
In the aforesaid view of the matter and as there is no dispute about the petitioners' entitlement,
this Court deems it appropriate to dispose of the Writ Petition with a direction to the respondents 1,2 and 4 to 6 to pay the compensation amount to the petitioners, pursuant to the Award dated 15.09.2021, as expeditiously as possible, at any rate, within a period of four (4) weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this Order.
Between vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170099773/
2 7.
The Writ Petition is disposed of accordingly, with the above directions.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, all the pending miscellaneous applications in the above writ petition, if any, shall stand closed.
opennyai_summary.21_July_2023__ANALYSIS:
Though the reasons are obvious as noted from the written instructions, the same cannot be appreciated and delay in payment effects the rights of the petitioners guaranteed under Articles 14 and 21 of the Constitution of India.
6.
Needless to state that this Order would not preclude the petitioners from claiming interest in respect of the awarded compensation before the appropriate Forum.

Between vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 14 August, 2023
Author: Ninala Jayasurya
Bench: Ninala Jayasurya
In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh :: Amaravati
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya
 Writ Petition No.19970 of 2023
Between:-
Badithaboina Apparao ..... Petitioner
 And
The State of Andhra Pradesh,
Represented by its Principal Secretary,
Revenue(Land Acquisition),
Secretariat, Velagapudi,
Amaravati, Guntur District & Others. ..... Respondents
Counsel for the Petitioner : Mr.Mahadeva Kanthrigala
Counsel for the Respondents : G.P. for Land Acquisition
 G.P. for Roads & Buildings
 Mr.S.S.Varma,
 Standing Counsel for Nhai
Order:
opennyai_summary.14_August_2023__facts: With their consent, the Writ Petition is disposed of at the stage of admission.
opennyai_summary.14_August_2023__arguments:
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the owner and possessor of the above mentioned shop, which was purchased under an Agreement of Sale in the year 2004 and since then, the petitioner is running the business and eking out his livelihood.
While so, the learned counsel submits that the respondents on 11.07.2023 came to the petitioner's shop and made some marks on the premise of widening the National High Way Road and to construct a bridge from Rajahmundry to Vizianagaram 516E.
He submits that the said action on the part of the respondents in trying to interfere with the petitioner's possession and attempting to dispossess the petitioner that too, without following procedure as contemplated under Law, is unsustainable and therefore, the petitioner is constrained to approach Between vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 14 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109056151/
1 this Court seeking appropriate reliefs.
4. The learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition while placing a copy of the written instructions dated 14.08.2023 received from the Deputy Executive Engineer(R&B), NH Sub-Division, Kakinada made her submissions.
opennyai_summary.14_August_2023__ANALYSIS:
As seen from the said instructions, it would appear that some land acquisition proposals are made for the reconstruction of minor bridge at Km.24/8 of NH- 516E, under the Road Safety Annual Plan for the year 2022-23.
Be that as it may.
opennyai_summary.14_August_2023__decision:
The relevant portion of instructions reads as follows:
"......It is submitted that land and structures would be acquired as per the LA Act 1956 and duly following all the statutory procedures only.
As on today neither the NH Department nor the Revenue department had forced the petitioner in any manner and if the property of the petitioner is required it will be done only after paying the required compensation only."
5.
In the light of the above stated position, this Court is of the opinion that the Writ Petition need not be kept pending and accordingly, the same is disposed of, with a direction to the respondents to follow the due process of Law, in the event, they intend to utilize the subject matter land for the purpose of reconstruction of minor bridge or otherwise.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, all pending applications shall stand closed.
